sources.title: Yamaha Motor Acquires Electric Marine Propulsion Manufacturer Torqeedo
sources.evidence: Torqeedo offers electric outboard/inboard motors, batteries and accessories; holds many patents and R&D, mass-production equipment and development resources. Acquisition intended to strengthen Marine CASE Electric capabilities and build small electric lineup, with future mid-range electric outboards.
sources.status: Cited primary source; public source record; consult the cited URL for evidence and limitations.

sources.title: Successful closing: Yamaha Motor closes acquisition of Torqeedo
sources.evidence: Acquisition closed; Torqeedo brings electric and hybrid drive systems, nearly two decades experience, >250 patents, series-production facilities and R&D. About Torqeedo: electric/hybrid drives 0.5–100 kW for commercial and recreational use, integrated systems.
sources.status: Cited primary source; public source record; consult the cited URL for evidence and limitations.

sources.title: Yamaha Motor to Begin Pre-orders of Next-Generation Boat Maneuvering System HARMO
sources.evidence: HARMO is electric propulsion unit + remote box + joystick; rim-drive, low-speed thrust, large rudder angle. 3.7 kW (9.9-hp equivalent), 102 kgf static thrust, 48 VDC, 55 kg motor unit, single/twin options; Europe preorders for spring 2022.
sources.status: Cited primary source; public source record; consult the cited URL for evidence and limitations.

sources.title: Next-Generation Electric Propulsion System – HARMO
sources.evidence: HARMO pairs electric propulsion with Helm Master EX; standard-outboard installation. Current page specifies max impeller shaft output 3.1 kW, 48 V, 58–64 kg, 9.9-ps comparable petrol outboard; autopilot course/speed functions via Helm Master EX.
sources.status: Cited primary source; public source record; consult the cited URL for evidence and limitations.

sources.title: HELM MASTER EX
sources.evidence: Integrated DEC/DES/autopilot/joystick system; course/heading hold, waypoint Track Point, SetPoint position modes and bow-thruster integration. Wireless control supports single–quint engine boats; compatibility stated across current Yamaha DEC outboards F150–F425. It is Yamaha-designed/manufactured and plug-and-play within Yamaha ecosystem.
sources.status: Cited primary source; public source record; consult the cited URL for evidence and limitations.

sources.title: Marine Products: Marine Engines
sources.evidence: Engine categories are outboard, stern-drive and inboard; outboards 2–450 hp, cumulative production 13m in 2022, sold in ~180 territories and >90% exported. Production listed: Fukuroi South (medium/large 4-stroke and large 2-stroke), Kumamoto (small/medium 4-stroke/2-stroke).
sources.status: Cited primary source; public source record; consult the cited URL for evidence and limitations.

sources.title: V8 5.6-liter 450–400ps specifications
sources.evidence: XTO V8 4-stroke, 5,559 cm3, 400–450 ps class (product page). This is a high-output outboard; no evidence here of generator duty, continuous rating, shaft/interface compatibility or hybrid genset integration.
sources.status: Cited primary source; public source record; consult the cited URL for evidence and limitations.

sources.title: Marine Products Business Medium-Term Management Plan 2025–2027
sources.evidence: Marine CASE direction: integrated boats; integrated control by boat brain; collaborate with external partners. Torqeedo Europe electric development/manufacture/field evaluation; Japan engine development/manufacture/testing; U.S. advanced technology/field evaluations. R&D expenses 1.7x and capital investment 1.8x prior MTP; large-outboard capacity expansion and co-creation.
sources.status: Cited primary source; public source record; consult the cited URL for evidence and limitations.

sources.title: Marine Products Business Presentation / Fukuroi South Factory tour
sources.evidence: Four outboard production bases (Japan Fukuroi/Kumamoto; Thailand; Brazil), ~330,000 units in 2023; Fukuroi makes ~50%, mid/large models, with 2024 plan +20% vs 2018 and further +15% vs 2024 by 2026. Presentation reports Helm Master EX autodocking GPS-guided version targeted for 2024, and Y-FSH inboard maneuvering jointly developed with Toyota.
sources.status: Cited primary source; public source record; consult the cited URL for evidence and limitations.

sources.title: Marine Products: Boats
sources.evidence: Yamaha has made FRP boats since 1960 and is a comprehensive hull/engine/peripheral/service maker. Production: Yamaha Marine Hokkaido (fishing/utility), Yamaha Amakusa (small/medium utility), Skeeter (bass boats, group company, Texas), G3 (aluminum boats, U.S. subsidiary brand, Missouri).
sources.status: Cited primary source; public source record; consult the cited URL for evidence and limitations.

sources.title: Yamaha Motor Acquires Telwater
sources.evidence: Yamaha Motor Australia signed purchase agreement to acquire all Telwater shares from BRP subsidiaries; Telwater makes Australian aluminum boats under Quintrex, Stacer, Savage. Strategic intent: strengthen marine foundations, Australian sales network and outboard business; status should be confirmed post-clearances.
sources.status: Cited primary source; public source record; consult the cited URL for evidence and limitations.

sources.title: Yamaha Motor Acquires US Smart boat tech Company Siren Marine
sources.evidence: Yamaha intended full Siren acquisition under Yamaha Marine Systems (California). Siren hardware/software remotely monitors battery, bilge, power and location/theft. Supports Marine CASE Connected/IoT and high-value services; terms/status announcement did not disclose price.
sources.status: Cited primary source; public source record; consult the cited URL for evidence and limitations.

sources.title: Yamaha to Purchase Siren Marine
sources.evidence: Siren products retained brand; development teams in Newport and Kennesaw; connected products planned. Siren supplies monitoring of battery, bilge, temperature, location and stakeholder data for OEMs/boatbuilders. Yamaha U.S. unit markets 2.5–425 hp outboards, fiberglass jet-drive sport boats and PWCs; peripheral manufacturing includes Kracor, Bennett, Yamaha Marine Precision Propellers.
sources.status: Cited primary source; public source record; consult the cited URL for evidence and limitations.
